fig_adam_codesign_graph: Agentic Co-Design Graph. Agents exchange structured handoff objects, risk edges activate additional roles, and verifier edges connect candidates to independent evidence-producing gates.
fig_adam_risk_activation: Risk-activated evidence collaboration. ADAM scores a candidate, activates the necessary collaboration subgraph, assigns evidence obligations, selects the next experiment by value, and stops or rolls back when the evidence policy demands it.
fig_adam_bench_design: Planned ADAM-CoDesignBench composition. The benchmark is designed around 300 engineering tasks spanning real historical work, controlled defect injection, cross-layer integration, and hidden evaluation.
